ambiguous_objective: Symmetric interval around 0.5 containing the closest 20 percent of deterministic calibrated probabilities; inclusive ties
std_objective: Escalate at or above the 80th percentile of MC population standard deviation among ambiguous validation rows, or on mean/deterministic class disagreement
selection: Among passing pass budgets, minimize measured mean selective UQ cost; tie-break fewer passes. If none pass, propose NoUncertaintyPolicy and no escalation; retain 5-pass selective cascade only as a negative ablation.
score_semantics: Final tier deterministic calibrated probability; MC summaries route only. Never average tiers.
limitations: Fit-set diagnostics, reused validation data, one family seed; no statistical generalization claim. Cost thresholds are engineering budgets declared before MC sampling. Frozen deterministic temperatures applied to MC samples are not claimed to recalibrate the MC predictive mean.
